title: Let go
description: An unsent note for something you are still carrying. This is not forgiveness, and it does not excuse what happened.
privacy: Nothing is saved, uploaded or sent.
settle_copy: Feel your feet against the floor. Let your shoulders drop, then allow one slow exhale before you write.
prompt: Say what happened, what you felt, and what you needed.
prompt_hint: Try to describe rather than relive. You can stop at any moment.
placeholder: What I needed you to understand was…
complete_heading: You set it down for now.
complete_copy: It does not have to be solved tonight.
